console.description: This is a list of games released on the Game Boy Advance handheld video game system. The number of licensed games in this list is 1538, organized alphabetically by the games' localized English titles, or, when Japan-exclusive, their rōmaji transliterations. This list does not include Game Boy Advance Video releases.
